messages.content:
Interconnect HQ and Branch over a GRE tunnel, then encrypt the GRE traffic with IPsec. LAN subnets 10.1.0.0/16 and 10.2.0.0/16.

HQ fw eth2=203.0.113.2, branch peer eth2=203.0.114.2; LANs 10.1.0.0/16 (HQ) and 10.2.0.0/16 (branch).
PLAN:
ip tunnel add gre1 mode gre local 203.0.113.2 remote 203.0.114.2 ttl 255
ip addr add 172.16.0.1/30 dev gre1; ip link set gre1 up
ip route add 10.2.0.0/16 dev gre1
swanctl --load-all && swanctl --initiate --child gre-esp
